note.en: TODO verify: seeded from spec section 9.2. All NZ universities: full IB Diploma + 24 points = University Entrance. Individual programmes (medicine, engineering, law) set higher points/subject/interview requirements - always link out to the official page. Only Auckland and Otago have a source named in the spec; the other six carry sourceUrl=null until the official IB admission page is confirmed.
note.zh: 待核实：数据来自规格第 9.2 节。所有 NZ 大学：完整 IB 文凭 + 24 分 = University Entrance。具体专业（医学、工程、法律）另有更高分数/科目/面试要求，务必链接到官网。规格中仅奥克兰与奥塔哥给出来源；其余六所 sourceUrl 暂为 null，待补官方 IB 入学页面。

notes.en: UE literacy: English Language A (HL/SL) or English Language B (HL); numeracy: any Mathematics. Note: school leavers cannot apply directly to the MBChB (medicine) - they apply via First Year entry after starting an approved first-year programme.
notes.zh: UE 读写：英语 Language A（HL/SL）或英语 Language B（HL）；算术：任一数学。注意：高中毕业生不能直接申请 MBChB（医学），需先入读认可的大学一年级课程后按 First Year entry 申请。

note.en: MBChB entry route verified 2026-09-20: 'School leavers cannot apply directly to the MBChB; they are advised to apply via First Year entry.' The UE line still needs a source of its own.
note.zh: MBChB 入口于 2026-09-20 核实，官方原文：「School leavers cannot apply directly to the MBChB; they are advised to apply via First Year entry.」UE 那句仍需单独来源。
